AestheticEye, our face trauma surgeons are skilled in addressing the aftermath of injuries to restore both appearance and functionality. From fractures to soft tissue injuries, we provide comprehensive care to help patients recover fully.

Comprehensive Reconstructive Procedures for the Eyes

At AestheticEye, we offer a wide range of oculofacial reconstructive surgeries to address various conditions and needs. Our Cincinnati clinic services include:

  • Anophthalmos/Loss of an Eye
  • Dacryocystorhinostomy
  • Ectropion Repair
  • Entropion Repair
  • Enucleation / Evisceration
  • Eye Twitching | Blepharospasm
  • Eyelid Malposition
  • Eyelid Reconstruction
  • Eyelid Retraction Surgery
  • Facial Paralysis and Bell’s Palsy
  • Orbital Decompression
  • Orbital Tumors
  • Ptosis or Droopy Eyelids
  • Punctoplasty
  • Reconstructive Surgery After Eyelid Skin Cancer
  • Removal of Eyelid Lesion
  • Revisional Eyelid Surgery
  • Stye or Chalazion Drainage
  • Surgical Treatment of Tearing
  • Thyroid Eye Disease

Face Trauma Surgeons with Advanced Techniques

Our approach to oculofacial reconstructive surgery is highly personalized. During your consultation, Dr. Henson and Dr. Pargament will conduct a thorough evaluation to understand your specific needs and goals. They will develop a customized treatment plan using advanced surgical techniques to achieve optimal results. Our team is known for exceptional care when it comes to reconstructing the eyes after face trauma

Why Choose AestheticEye?

Board-Certified Expertise

Dr. Henson and Dr. Pargament are board-certified oculoplastic surgeons with extensive experience in reconstructive surgery.

Advanced Training

Both surgeons have advanced training in ophthalmology and oculoplastic surgery, ensuring a deep understanding of both the functional and aesthetic aspects of the eye and facial structures.

Comprehensive Care

We offer a full range of reconstructive procedures, from minor repairs to complex surgeries, to address a wide variety of conditions.

Patient-Centered Approach

Our team is dedicated to providing compassionate and personalized care, ensuring that each patient feels comfortable and supported throughout their treatment journey.
